build_alibi_tensor: build an ALiBi tensor with linear attention biases for a given number of attention heads
create_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask tensor for self-attention in the BLOOM transformer model
run_bloom_attention: run the BLOOM attention mechanism with fused QKV projection and tensor parallelism support
run_bloom_mlp: run the BLOOM MLP feed-forward layer with GELU activation and residual connection
run_bloom_causal_lm: run the BLOOM causal language model for text generation with speculative decoding head outputs
